models_rule_policy_vollstaendig.name: models_rule_policy_vollstaendig

app_tools_einstufung_passt_zum_stand.name: app_tools_einstufung_passt_zum_stand

app_tools_beweis_nur_bei_einstufung.name: app_tools_beweis_nur_bei_einstufung

belege_aktion_nur_bei_entscheidung_und_e.name: belege_aktion_nur_bei_entscheidung_und_ergebnis
belege_aktion_nur_bei_entscheidung_und_e.value: ("public"."belege"."entry_type" in ('decision', 'result')) = ("public"."belege"."action_id" is not null and "public"."belege"."action" is not null and "public"."belege"."actor" is not null)

belege_spalten_aus_koerper.name: belege_spalten_aus_koerper

conversations_bot_oder_team.name: conversations_bot_oder_team
conversations_bot_oder_team.value: ("public"."conversations"."kind" in ('direkt', 'entwurf') and "public"."conversations"."bot_id" is not null and "public"."conversations"."team_id" is null) or ("public"."conversations"."kind" = 'faden' and "public"."conversations"."bot_id" is null and "public"."conversations"."team_id" is not null)

messages_eine_antwort_je_lauf.name: messages_eine_antwort_je_lauf

messages_schritt_nur_bot.name: messages_schritt_nur_bot

tool_calls_server_nur_bei_mcp.name: tool_calls_server_nur_bei_mcp

tool_calls_ergebnis_nur_wenn_erledigt.name: tool_calls_ergebnis_nur_wenn_erledigt

tool_calls_app_angaben_zusammen.name: tool_calls_app_angaben_zusammen
